title.description: Plain-language title of the change, without legal citations.

summary.description: The whole change in one or two sentences. Never empty.

who.description: Who this concerns, in everyday words rather than tag names.

when.description: When it applies; a date placeholder, or the rule when no date is fixed yet.

what_to_do.description: Only where to read more and whom to ask. Never an instruction to the reader.

placeholders_used.description: Every placeholder written into the sections, e.g. amount:blue_card_salary_threshold.new.
